candidate_a_presentation.measure_label: Share with at least one 2024 encounter linked in MEPS to an exact U09 condition record
candidate_a_presentation.always_visible_explanation: This is not the share diagnosed or recognized with Long COVID and does not measure Long-COVID-attributable healthcare use.
technical_limitations: Exact U09 is not equivalent to the governed operational-current Long COVID definition.
Absence of U09 does not mean absence of Long COVID.
Absence of a qualifying linked encounter does not mean absence of healthcare.
Calendar-year 2024 encounters may occur before or after the Round 3/1 current-status anchor.
Condition-event linkage does not establish causation.
116 of 259 qualifying U09-linked events also carry at least one non-U09 condition link.
